views.title: Crush on Wi-Fi at its peak. Let go when it's weak.

views.markdown:
**iOS has a toxic relationship with weak Wi-Fi.**

Even when your signal drops to a pathetic 1 bar, your iPhone refuses to let go. Videos buffer endlessly, webpages freeze, and FaceTime calls turn into a robotic slideshow. Your only escape is opening Control Center and switching networks or toggling mobile data by hand - over and over again.

**WifiCrush fixes that.** It teaches your iPhone how to love strong Wi-Fi, and more importantly, when to walk away.

Pick the network you love (your **crush**) and your iPhone stays loyal to it. When your crush gets too weak, WifiCrush smoothly hops to a stronger backup Wi-Fi nearby, then brings you right back once your crush recovers. Love your ultra-fast 5 GHz network, even with its short range? Walk into another room and WifiCrush switches to your 2.4 GHz network for better reach, then returns to 5 GHz the moment you walk back.

**It gets even better with 4G/5G.**

Set the minimum signal threshold you are happy with. The instant every Wi-Fi around you drops below it, WifiCrush cuts the dead weight and fires up 4G/5G - fast and decisively. Walking out the front door in the middle of an important Wi-Fi or FaceTime call? Your call stays alive without a single hiccup. Once you are back in solid Wi-Fi, mobile data turns off automatically to save battery. Simple, quiet, and completely hands-free.

👉 **See it in action side-by-side with a stock iPhone:** https://pitroytech.github.io/wificrush-landing/

🎬 **Watch the short demo video:** https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Tju8PySPVTw

## ✨ Features

- **Visual Radar UI:** A clean, intuitive page showing your iPhone in the center surrounded by your saved networks, mapped out live by signal strength.
- **Pick up to 3 Crush Networks:** Stay loyal to your favorite networks, even when another random saved Wi-Fi nearby is slightly stronger.
- **Smart Wi-Fi Roaming:** Automatically jumps to a clearly stronger saved network when your crush weakens, and returns as soon as it is strong again.
- **Instant 4G/5G Fallback:** All Wi-Fi weak? Mobile data kicks in within seconds. A minute later, WifiCrush quietly checks the airwaves and makes the smartest next move.
- **Zero-Drop Call Protection:** If Wi-Fi drops while you are on a call, WifiCrush switches to 4G/5G immediately and locks it there until you hang up - no mid-call reconnections to ruin your conversation.
- **Verified Internet Return:** Mobile data only turns off after 30 seconds of stable Wi-Fi, and **only** after a quick ping check (via Google, Cloudflare, and Apple servers) confirms you actually have working Internet.
- **5 GHz Priority:** Smartly prefers 5 GHz over 2.4 GHz when the signal gap is small.
- **One-Tap "Strongest Mode":** Temporarily lock onto the absolute strongest Wi-Fi around you for a custom duration with a single tap.
- **Control Center Integration (CCSupport):** Tap the tile for a quick Wi-Fi list, or hold to open the app. Plus, an optional tweak to make iOS's stock CC Wi-Fi button turn Wi-Fi **completely** off.

## 🎁 Special Offer

Already own **5Row Pro**? Get $1 off WifiCrush automatically - just **$1.49** instead of $2.49!

## ⚠️ Read Before Buying

- **Compatibility:** Supports Rootless and RootHide jailbreaks on **iOS 15 and later**. Tested and daily-driven on iOS 17.2.1 Dopamine (iPhone 15 Pro Max), iOS 15.2 RootHide (iPhone 12 Pro Max), and iOS 15.3.1 Rootless (iPhone 6s).
- **How it works:** WifiCrush intelligently switches between your saved Wi-Fi networks and mobile data to keep your connection alive. It does not boost physical router range or ISP speed.
- **Dependencies:** Requires **PreferenceLoader**. The Control Center tile requires **CCSupport** (optional).

## 🔒 Activation & Privacy

Sign in to Havoc in your package manager, purchase WifiCrush, open the app, and tap **Activate** - done! WifiCrush respects your privacy 100%: no Wi-Fi names, no location data, and no usage stats are ever collected. Once activated, it works completely offline.

## 💬 Support

Need help? Email me at **pitroytechcode@gmail.com** with your iOS version, jailbreak environment, and a brief description of the issue. If activation fails, the activation screen displays a device code and a quick email button - please include that code so I can sort it out for you quickly!
